description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for filtering search parameters related to reviewing employees and their supervisors within the OrangeHRM Performance module. The class includes properties for employee number and name or ID, with getter and setter methods, and specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: ReviewEmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating filter parameters used when searching for employee-supervisor review data in the performance context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter object and sets the default sort field to 'employee.empNumber'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the name or ID filter value.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID filter value.
